posts.title: Written With AI, Not by AI
posts.description: My content is written with AI, and that's not a secret. The only question worth asking is whether the thinking was yours.

posts.title: There Is No Intelligence in Artificial Intelligence
posts.description: You've probably said 'thank you' to ChatGPT. So have I. It feels odd not to, which is exactly the problem.

posts.title: Typing Code Was Never the Job
posts.description: If your job was mostly typing, you were always one productivity improvement away from being redundant. AI just made that improvement real.
